decisions: Use native installed Node; no dependency installation or bundle.
Unmodified helper parameter properties require --experimental-transform-types on eventual execution.
Worker verification uses node --check on .mjs files only. Lead separately verified four TypeScript import-only loads; no typecheck or numerical-control proof is claimed.
Use asynchronous spawn with shell:false; never substitute spawnSync for an authoritative supervisor.
Bound materialized protocol frames and visible read chunks, reject unexpected stderr and strict-schema violations.
Suppress only documented ExperimentalWarning for native TypeScript transformation; stderr fails except the bounded recognized OOM banner with abnormal exit, which is NOTRUN pf2_heap_cap.
Check the parent monotonic deadline after validation/serialization and at publication completion; timers alone have no exact scheduling guarantee.
The child receives an advisory remaining duration and rehashes the exact verified fixture bytes; parent is authoritative.
Publication is a complete-frame plus process-exit commit protocol requiring explicit review, not an atomic-stdout-write claim.
Cleanup observes ChildProcess close explicitly, never equating kill requests or exit events alone with close.
Paused-mode frame/notice readers and flowing-data child stderr with an 8192-byte retained prefix do not prove a bound on native-private queues.
The outer consumer never kills the parent automatically, because doing so can orphan a numerical child; it requests cooperative cleanup and reports unresolved resources.
